implementation_strategy: Hosted-model API calls (gpt-5-mini) for all generation; Docker-based Mininet-like CPU emulation for executable validation and deterministic instrumentation. Deterministic decoding (temperature=0) and token-log-prob / response-hash logging where provider supports it. All scoring and mapping from emulator traces to binary semantic-failure labels performed by deterministic scorer scripts contained in the harness. No human scoring or adjudication.
task_manifest_strategy: Prebuilt curated intent→configuration taskset of N=120 public/synthetic tasks; deterministic assignment to three topology clusters (edge/core/leaf–spine) with 40 tasks each. Fixed manifest and canonical task identifiers recorded and checksummed prior to execution.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Frozen transformations: intent_canonicalizer_v1; prompt_template_v1 (base) + two fixed perturbation variants; config_syntactic_normalizer_v1; guarded loop invokes emulator-mapped validator and at most one automated repair iteration per intervention episode.
randomisation_plan: Deterministic assignment of tasks to topology clusters as preregistered (no stochastic allocation). Fixed hashed audit seed = 42 used for deterministic audit-sample selection and any internal pseudorandom decisions; seed recorded in execution metadata.
caching_plan: Cache all LLM responses, parsed configuration artifacts, and emulator traces with SHA256 checksums. Reuse cached model responses only for deterministic replay and auditing; no cached responses substituted across different tasks or conditions. Emulator container images are checksum-verified prior to each task run.
failure_recovery_plan: All recovery automated: on emulator/container startup failure, automated container restart attempted up to 2 times (Docker). If emulator provisioning still fails, the task pair is logged, checksummed, and excluded from primary confirmatory analysis per preregistered missingness_plan. Model-API transient errors: single automated retry of the API call permitted only for transport-level failures; model-generation attempts per-call limited to 1 by contract. All failures classified and archived with artifact hashes.
result_schema: Episode-level JSON per paired_binary_episode_v1: fields {task_id, condition (baseline|guarded), model_name, model_version, prompt_hash, response_text, response_hash, response_tokens, response_logprobs (if available), syntactic_parse_pass (bool), syntactic_parse_errors (list), emulator_run_id, emulator_trace_checksum, semantic_failure_label (pass|fail), failure_mode_taxonomy (if fail), model_call_duration_ms, timestamp, execution_metadata_checksum}. Paired analysis executor consumes two episodes per task and emits paired outcome record with hashes.
estimated_compute_notes: CPU-only Docker emulation (Mininet-like) per task; hosted-model API calls limited to 240 total calls (120 baseline + 120 guarded). Estimated wall time: under 7 days including setup and deterministic audits given parallel batch scheduling (12 sequential batches recommended to respect provider rate limits). Model-call budget equals maximum_model_calls (240); plan fits frozen capability manifest limits (no local GPU required).
